evidence.quote: Although bank credit remains tight, I see some reasons for optimism. Economic activity has continued to strengthen.
Clearly that objective has not yet been realized, as bank lending continues to contract and terms and conditions remain tight.
Also, with credit demand tepid and the economy still under stress, profitable lending opportunities have been relatively scarce for many of these banks.
Consequently, restoring the flow of credit through the banking system remains a central objective of the Federal Reserve.

parsed.rationale: The speech is mainly about bank supervision and the stress test, with no monetary policy signal. It offers mixed observations on activity and tight credit, which tilt slightly dovish.
